variants.prompt: Create ONE finished CrazyGames LANDSCAPE game cover, exact output 1920 x 1080 pixels, 16:9, opaque full bleed. Reference 1 is the exact COIN TOWER title logo: golden COIN with crown above and white TOWER with rich blue bevel/outline. Preserve this spelling and distinctive letterforms. Reference 2 is the thick gold coin with crown embossed on its face and ribbed edge. Reference 3 is the cream stone cylindrical pedestal with gold bands, gold crown emblem and green vines. Reference 4 is the bright blue sky, pale stone sky ruins, blue/gold banners and turquoise waterfalls. Extend/reframe the background to fill the landscape canvas naturally. Composition: oversized readable two-line title on the LEFT about 46% of canvas width, centered vertically in the upper-middle; on the RIGHT a prominent tall vertical stack of 7-8 separate gold coins resting on the matching pedestal, plus ONE crown coin descending horizontally just above the stack with a visible small gap. All stacked coins are horizontal and face up like the provided coin, not upright casino coins. Tower occupies the right half and pedestal sits near bottom with entire silhouette visible. Keep each coin crisp and substantial, a few tiny gold glints at the landing point, no excessive particles. Keep the crown top, title, falling coin and base at least 4% away from canvas boundaries. Bright inviting blue versus gold palette, clean high-quality casual 2D game illustration, strong shapes readable at thumbnail size, restrained background detail behind title. NO extra text: only COIN TOWER. NO HUD, score, numbers, Perfect, buttons, tap to play, shop icons, store logos, badges, borders, letterboxing, watermark or rounded canvas corners. Do not include black/transparent backgrounds from the reference previews. Export the single complete cover at exactly 1920x1080.
